text:
laura: Heads-up 5 PioneerAnalytics sent an enterprise questionnaire asking for RBAC approval records, audit log exports with tamper proofing, KMS key provenance, vuln triage evidence, and a redacted postmortem. They want an initial bundle in 72h.
jake: can you paste the exact asks? makes it easier to scope.
laura: pasted excerpt:
- RBAC: list of change requests + approver attestations (last 6 months), PDF signatures if possible
- Audit logs: export for tenant pioneer for 2025-02-01..2025-02-28, manifest + checksum, retention policy statement
- KMS: key creation events, who/what created master keys, rotation schedule, whether HSM-backed
- Vulnerability mgmt: triage timestamps for critical/high in last 6 months, example evidence
- Incident response: redacted postmortem within last 12 months, runbook excerpt, escalation matrix
anita: i can own RBAC + signatures. we have approvals stored under approvals-bucket/{team}/YYYY/MM with email thread and generated approval PDF. ill pull the last 6 months and generate signed PDFs (redacted) and upload to s3://evidence-redacted/pioneer/rbac/.
troy: logs/export side: we use object-lock S3 + manifest with sha256 in log-index. i can run infractl logs export --tenant=pioneer --start=2025-02-01 --end=2025-02-28 --out pioneer-feb-2025.tar.gz and compute sha256. ETA ~1.5h for a 30d window.
nadia: KMS provenance: production CMKs are HSM-backed where available; for hosted we use AWS KMS MRK or CMK depending on region. cloudtrail contains keyCreate, scheduleKeyRotation events. i will pull CloudTrail events for the key ARNs and include eventId + eventTime + userIdentity. example event id: e3b2c4d5-2025-02-20T09:15:00Z (created by infra-keygen@redwood.com).
laura: legal asked if customers need an attestation or just exported events. Pioneer asked for "evidence of creation with identity binding". legal prefers not to add attestation language; provide raw CloudTrail events + mapping doc.
jake: vuln triage: our SLA is ack <24h, initial classification <72h. we have a policy doc. examples: CVE-2025-3456 (high) triaged 2025-01-10 acked within 6h, patch staged day+3. i can attach redacted triage tickets INC-6102.
anita: about PDFs: some approver entries are service accounts (automation). Pioneer said they want "signed approvals" we should mark automation ones as system approvals and include a short note about automation identity and auth method.
troy: export job kicked off. command output: \n```\n$ infractl logs export --tenant=pioneer --start=2025-02-01 --end=2025-02-28 --out pioneer-feb-2025.tar.gz\nExport job started: job-77821\nEstimated size: 6.2GB\n```\nwill post checksum when complete.
nadia: pulled CloudTrail events for keys used by Pioneer. sample event excerpt will include eventId, userIdentity. If key created by automation, include the automation IAM ARN and the pipeline run id. I will also note whether key is MRK or single-region CMK.
laura: IR artifact: we have a redacted postmortem for the 2025-03-05 incident (latency spike; autoscaler race). owner signoffs included. I'll redact tenant names and customer IPs and upload to s3://evidence-redacted/pioneer/ir/.
jake: small snag: one RBAC approval email lost full approver display name due to SSO sync around 2025-01-15. HR lookup confirms the approver, added note in metadata. Pioneer asked for signatures > we can provide email headers plus generated approval PDFs stamped by system.
troy: export done. artifact: pioneer-feb-2025.tar.gz
sha256: a7c9d1e4b2f3c6d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d
manifest: s3://evidence-exports/pioneer/2025-02/manifest.json (contains file list + checksums). published manifest hash also recorded in log-index.
anita: RBAC PDFs uploaded to s3://evidence-redacted/pioneer/rbac/ with filenames req-59012.pdf, req-60321.pdf, req-61142.pdf. Service account approvals marked.
nadia: CloudTrail exports zipped: pioneer-kms-provenance-2025-02.zip
sha256: 4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5
include example event id e3b2c4d5-2025-02-20T09:15:00Z (userIdentity: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/infra-keygen).
laura: draft cover note: "Hi PioneerAnalytics security team, attached is a redacted evidence bundle addressing your questionnaire. Artifacts include RBAC approvals (redacted PDFs), audit log export with manifest and checksums, CloudTrail events for KMS key creation, vuln triage tickets, and a redacted postmortem. Let us know any further scope or if you require an onsite attestation."
jake: legal asked to include a short statement about redaction process. add note: "Identifying customer data removed; all timestamps and system identifiers preserved."
anita: one more: Pioneer requested notarized PDFs for approver signatures. legal says we can't notarize internal emails; suggest signed affidavit from security director instead. tagging legal.
laura: ok team. action items: anita (RBAC PDFs), troy (logs + manifest), nadia (CloudTrail provenance), laura (IR redaction + cover). aim to hand off draft bundle to sales by 2025-04-02 EOD.
evidence-bot: auto-pack command queued: /evidence pack --scope=rbac,logs,kms,ir,vuln --tenant=pioneer --out=pioneer-evidence-draft-2025-04-02.tar.gz
laura: thanks all. drop links here once uploads are available and i'll assemble final tar. ping @legal if they insist on notarization or attestation.
